verdict.rationale: Brex documents AI assistants that write memos, fetch receipts and file reimbursements (brex-docs-23), AI agents that categorize, review and approve spend against policy (brex-docs-41, brex-docs-8), and an audit agent that monitors expenses and ranks potential violations by risk (brex-docs-15, brex-docs-16). Receipt upload with automatic matching is also documented (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-27), and a community commenter confirms AI use for fraud/risk and auto-generated receipts (brex-comm-4). Missing for 10: explicit duplicate-expense detection, first-party documentation of fraud detection on expenses, detail on how receipts are read (OCR/field extraction), and independent hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
